project.name: Template maintenance
project.purpose: Implement approved bounded governance and synthetic testing architecture
project.scope: Approved six-item plan in this session
project.exclusions: Remote adapters, existing data migration, publication
acceptance_criteria: Approved plan implemented with review and validation

data.retention: Retain review evidence; disposable test data
data.raw_policy: Read-only originals; transformations go to data/processed/
data.git_policy: Exclude data contents by default; track folder placeholders only; small fixtures require explicit approval

handoffs.policy: Built-in fields and handoffs/ directory; builder to reviewer to tester

tasks: One reviewable feature per task; built-in states and evidence checks
prompts: Log feature requests, material scope changes, and assignments; retain in Git; redact secrets before writing
memory: Save a feature memory after each task; record significant decisions and milestones in logging/journal.jsonl; retrieve compact entries by default; retain history in Git
tokens: Concise outputs; compact at phase boundaries or context pressure after saving a handoff; usage only when exposed
approvals: User approved the final six-item plan and all assumptions in this conversation
delivery: Local reviewable changes, no merge or publication
execution_boundary: All deterministic components MUST use Python scripts; third-party libraries are allowed in applications. Evaluate existing dependencies and suitable maintained libraries before custom equivalents. Install new packages only within explicitly approved scope, using the project virtual environment and dependency manifest/lockfile. The core harness remains standard-library-only. Models handle judgment only. Clarify ambiguous cases with the user before implementation.
